component.name: Roost
component.summary: Organise, tag and find your visual assets

description.p: Roost is a local-first digital asset manager for images, videos, documents and design files. It keeps them in a library on your own disk, and gives you folders, tags, ratings, notes and a fast search over all of them.

ul.li: Thumbnails for photographs, RAW and HEIC, video, PDF, SVG and fonts
Folders and subfolders, tags in groups, ratings, notes and timed comments
Search across names, notes and comments, with filters by tag, rating and type
Files are edited in place by the applications that own them, and Roost notices the save
Imports an existing Eagle library, with its folders, tags and notes

description.p: The library is an open format: the files themselves, and a plain-text journal of everything written about them. Roost needs no account and makes no network connection.
